name: Green Divers Barbados
summary: Green Divers is a women-owned dive centre at Savvy on the Bay in Carlisle Bay, open since February 2026 and the first PADI Eco Center in Barbados. It runs small-group morning and afternoon boat dives on reefs and wrecks, PADI courses from Discover Scuba to Divemaster, and monthly clean-up dives and lionfish hunts.
standouts: First PADI Eco Center in Barbados
Free refresher session for divers who have not dived in a year

checkNotes: All services and prices were read from the data embedded in the operator's own Wix Bookings page (/book-online), which lists every service with its USD price; the page states 'All prices are quoted in USD'. Each service has its own Wix booking page on the operator's domain, recorded in bookingLinks. Courses and DSD take a deposit by payment link after booking. Booking-widget slot lengths were not used as course durations. The FAQ says the boat 'Out of Air' is a 23ft Mako carrying a maximum of 7 divers with up to 3 staff, while the dive experience page says a 22ft Mako with a maximum of 8 guests. WhatsApp number is shown as text (+447346006590), not as a wa.me link. Photos on the Dive Conservation page are credited to photographer Keshia Kuhn (unnaturallynaturalviews.com) and were left out everywhere. DiveFest Barbados 2026 (16 to 22 August) has passed, so it is not listed. The shop opened in February 2026.
